items.title_en: Hurricane Isaias disrupts U.S. oil production in Gulf of Mexico, threatens refineries
items.title_zh: 飓风伊萨亚斯扰乱美国墨西哥湾石油生产，威胁炼油厂
items.desc_en: The hurricane could tighten a fuel market that is already facing big disruptions from the wars in Eastern Europe and the Middle East.

items.title_en: Trump appoints committee to investigate statements by the Fed's Lisa Cook
items.title_zh: 特朗普任命委员会调查美联储丽莎·库克的言论
items.desc_en: Trump tried to fire Cook, a nominee of former President Joe Biden, but the Supreme Court blocked his first attempt.
items.desc_zh: 特朗普试图解雇前总统乔·拜登的提名人库克，但最高法院阻止了他的第一次尝试。

items.title_en: This AI infrastructure stock will rise on agentic AI boom, Bank of America says
items.title_zh: 美国银行表示，人工智能基础设施股将因人工智能热潮而上涨
items.desc_en: Penguin Solutions is likely to be a major beneficiary of the potential agentic AI boom, which should support its share growth, per Bank of America.
items.desc_zh: 根据美国银行的说法，企鹅解决方案可能是潜在的代理人工智能热潮的主要受益者，这应该会支持其份额增长。

items.title_en: Americans' debt problems are flashing a warning not seen since the Great Recession
items.title_zh: 美国债务问题正发出大衰退以来未曾见过的警告
items.desc_en: Researchers found that while wealth disparities narrowed somewhat, the ability to meet debt payments deteriorated significantly.
items.desc_zh: 研究人员发现，虽然贫富差距有所缩小，但偿还债务的能力却大幅恶化。

items.title_en: ICE won't pause enforcement in NY after Bronx shooting, DHS's Mullin says
items.title_zh: 国土安全部穆林表示，布朗克斯枪击事件后，ICE 不会暂停在纽约的执法
items.desc_en: New York Gov. Kathy Hochul said she asked Homeland Security Secretary Mullin and President Donald Trump to immediately halt ICE operations in her state.
items.desc_zh: 纽约州州长凯西·霍赫尔表示，她要求国土安全部部长穆林和总统唐纳德·特朗普立即停止 ICE 在该州的行动。

items.title_en: Wall Street is pitching data centers as a major real estate bet. The risks are piling up
items.title_zh: 华尔街将数据中心视为房地产的主要赌注。风险正在堆积

items.desc_zh: 随着政治、流动性和项目风险的增加，华尔街公司正在将人工智能数据中心投资引入公开市场。

items.title_en: Three Saudi nationals killed in Houthi attacks on Riyadh airport
items.title_zh: 三名沙特公民在胡塞武装袭击利雅得机场时丧生
items.desc_en: The missile attacks come amid an escalation in fighting between the Iran-backed group and Saudi Arabia, which backs Yemen's government.
items.desc_zh: 此次导弹袭击发生之际，伊朗支持的组织与支持也门政府的沙特阿拉伯之间的战斗正在升级。

items.title_en: Delta Air Lines cuts 2026 forecast on fuel surge, but CEO says demand is still strong

items.desc_zh: 达美航空公布第三季度盈利，两年来首次低于华尔街预期。

items.title_en: Ethiopia warns Eritrea it will defend itself after troops cross border

items.title_en: Treasury's Bessent hires Trump's controversial former Fed board pick, Judy Shelton, as advisor

items.desc_en: Shelton's controversial economic ideas led the Senate to block her nomination to the Fed. Now she's going to be a counselor to the Treasury secretary.

items.desc_zh: 在期权交易场，交易员对自初夏以来科技股回调的准备最为充分。

items.desc_zh: 随着 29 岁的 Hy Luu 等投资者以投资组合为抵押借入更多资金，保证金债务已飙升至创纪录水平。以下是杠杆如何放大股票损失。

items.desc_zh: 该公司表示，用户不能再对这项技术进行“持续且不必要的”滥用行为。

items.desc_zh: 上个月，窃贼在法国里维埃拉的雷诺阿博物馆冲破栅栏并砸碎窗户时，这两件作品被没收。

items.desc_zh: 文森特·布朗博士据称是种族灭绝初期其他人实施的暴力行为的“领导者”或“监督者”。

items.title_en: France promises 3,000 extra teachers in first step to calm student protests

items.desc_zh: 该剧将接续 2018 年热门电影，由吴恬敏、亨利·戈尔丁、杨紫琼和罗尼·钱主演。
